title: Host source bases accept unsafe rendered characters, and root-generation history does not reset at a claim release
outcome: Host source bases accept unsafe rendered characters, and root-generation history does not reset at a claim release
acceptance: A decision recorded on the item says whether host-supplied workspace ids and source revisions must refuse unsafe rendered (control/format) characters on the admitted turn_checkpoint path, and the code and a test follow it

The source-root generation checks (validate_source_root_basis_on and the historical check rule) either reset at a claim release, since the claim id is reused after release, or the item records why history across a release is accepted, with a test

completion.summary: turn_checkpoint refuses new source-basis workspace ids and revisions holding a C0/C1 control or Bidi_Control character with source_basis_text_refused naming the field, after replay, persisting and echoing nothing; the resend under the same key is admitted. Root-generation history stays monotone across a claim release by decision (the claim id is reused), with a re-claim test. Docs in behavioral-control-plane.md. Store judgment: no durable row changes; readiness ready on all 4 stores.
